vis.scope: Single ordinary or Multi-MS input; required path, partition mutations, backups, HISTORY and returns are compared.

field.scope: Default and PHASE field selection preserve unselected rows. Complete FIELD grammar and combinations remain to be CASA compared.

spw.scope: CASA window and channel grammar serves applycal, including wildcard selection, channels, strides, descending and compressed windows. Whole-window selections stay implicit.

intent.scope: Native STATE grammar handles exact comma-separated OBS_MODE components, patterns, quoted patterns, regexes, intersections, IDs/ranges/bounds, flagged states, and partial numeric lists. Scalar literal text is preserved, including none. Intent remains active with selectdata=False. Current same-input cases pass; full callable/coercion and cross-parameter domains remain. Bounds mask flagged states while explicit IDs/ranges may select them; empty combined bounds reject before unioning, as CASA does.

selectdata.scope: When false, applycal accepts and ignores timerange/uvrange/antenna/scan/observation/msselect while retaining their original inputs for HISTORY. Field, SPW and intent still select. Public CASA comparisons pass; complete remaining API/coercion domains stay open.

timerange.scope: The shared CASA time grammar handles exact, range, duration, bound, wildcard and explicit buffer forms. The task wrapper removes a literal outer bracket pair before parsing.

uvrange.scope: Native UV-distance selection supports meter/km, lambda/klambda, default units, bounds/ranges, mixed-unit unions and whitespace; CASA comparisons cover combined selection, disabled values and errors/empty results. Full callable/coercion and cross-parameter domains remain.

antenna.scope: The shared CASA baseline grammar serves applycal, including lists, negation, distances and combinations with other selectors.

scan.scope: CASA numeric scan lists, ranges and comparisons use the shared grammar on applycal.

observation.scope: Scalar strings and integer observation IDs are kept in their original form for HISTORY and parsed by the shared observation grammar.

msselect.scope: Native TaQL selection exists; full CASA-supported forms, errors and mutation scope remain.

docallib.scope: Native task-library activation, inactive traditional controls and original flat-spwmap HISTORY are CASA-compared, including deferred parse-error setup. Full remaining callable/coercion domains stay open with the common task acceptance.

callib.scope: G/T/B task files follow CalLibraryGram typed/case-sensitive grammar, CWD paths, first table-level calwt, comma/newline entries, raw MS slices, buffer intent scope, field/observation/scan/antenna/SPW maps and overlap refusal. Missing axes use skip/strict rules; entirely unmapped antenna groups pass unflagged. Reach is retained but not consumed upstream. Remaining supported-family/chain and callable/state domains stay open. Literal relative library names and Multi-MS application are compared.

gaintable.scope: Traditional and library paths exercise supported Jones families. G/T/B/BPOLY/K, Antpos, opacity and gain-curve tables retain their coefficient, flag and weight behavior. Leakage Jones tables use four-product calibration and leave leakage weights unchanged.

gainfield.scope: Default application merges selected calibration fields in time. Numeric/name/glob/list/range forms and nearest mapping are CASA-compared, including selected-field SPW availability and nearest-field observation scope. Native restores the source-intended ambiguity error disabled by CASA sort options. Full grammar/coercion and remaining boundary combinations stay open.

interp.scope: Shared native time curves implement nearest/linear/cubic, corrected natural spline, per-observation/per-scan and PD controls; B frequency curves include nearest/linear/cubic/spline, flag registration and relative frequencies. Shifted grids, scalar B PD exclusion, missing context/antenna slices and compressed-grid copies are checked. Remaining family-specific and irregular-grid/error combinations stay on #1518.

spwmap.scope: Identity, scalar broadcast, partial prefixes, automatic -999 fanout and whole-list metadata validation are CASA-compared on multiple SPWs. Metadata windows without solutions use skip/strict behavior; field selection determines availability before mapping. Remaining coercion/chain and family domains remain.

calwt.scope: Per-table weights, single-value broadcast and short-list failure state are compared. Opacity and gain-curve terms now calibrate weights for their physical correction.

parang.scope: Standalone circular and full four-correlation linear feed rotation, selected channels, input-flag propagation, trial/flag-only modes and invalid two-linear-correlation error/state match CASA. Full chain/geometry/domain combinations remain.

applymode.scope: All six modes are implemented and CASA-compared, including unavailable SPWs, flag-only preservation, selected channels, new/existing corrected data and trial validation. Empty selections error in every native mode. Full remaining parameter/error combinations stay open.

flagbackup.scope: Backup is saved before selection/table validation in flag-writing modes, including rejected requests, matching CASA. Existing native restore checks and public backup counts pass. Full version contents/metadata and remaining API/error combinations remain.

behaviors.title: Apply chains while preserving unselected data and calibrated weight semantics
behaviors.scope: Ordinary and partitioned MeasurementSets, shared selectors and Python input forms, supported G/T/B/BPOLY/K and routine priors, calibration libraries, all six modes, backup, HISTORY and standalone parang.
behaviors.gap: New calibration families remain on their owning tickets under #979. Detailed performance tuning and final qualification follow functionality on #979.

behaviors.title: Apply linearized and full-matrix leakage to four polarization products
behaviors.scope: Linear and circular four-product data with D, Df, Dgen, Dfgen, DLLS and DfLLS tables. Includes variable time and channel solutions, G/D/P order, flags, missing antennas, subselected channels, and unequal scalar and spectral weights.
behaviors.gap: The permuted-correlation and malformed-table differences are documented below. Cross-hand phase families continue under #1522.

decisions.inputs: A consistent linear-feed CORR_TYPE order of XX, YY, XY, YX.
decisions.casa: Applies the correction to fixed slots and modifies a parallel hand.
decisions.ours: Applies the leakage correction and flags to the products named by the MeasurementSet.
decisions.rationale: The four-product layout is valid in casacore. Applying a cross-hand formula to a parallel hand changes the observed data incorrectly.
decisions.impact: The native output equals permuting the canonical-order result.
decisions.owner_decision: Correct CASA data corruption under the standing deviations rule. [Owner decision](https://github.com/bglenden/casa-rs/issues/1054)

decisions.inputs: A D Jones calibration table with one complex receptor per solution.
decisions.ours: Raises a catchable invalid calibration shape error.
decisions.rationale: Two coefficients are required for a four-product leakage correction.
decisions.impact: The caller can handle the malformed caltable without losing the process.
decisions.owner_decision: Correct CASA crashes and aborts under the standing deviations rule. [Owner decision](https://github.com/bglenden/casa-rs/issues/1054)

oracle.kind: Same-input public-Python MAIN/API/state comparison with explicit CASA-bug control
oracle.scope: 399 ordinary-MS scenarios with separate crash controls.
oracle.result: 397 direct CASA matches and two documented corrections on ordinary MeasurementSets, with five separate crash probes. The literal name/file none and rejected selectors match CASA state, without a tolerance change. NumPy HISTORY constructor spelling is normalized to the same list values, and raw records are retained.

source.scope: Calibrater::correct2, task_applycal.py/mstools.write_history, PJones::syncMeta2/calcOneJones, Jones flag propagation/inversion, VisEquation::collapse2, SIGMA reset, CTPatchedInterp frequency interpolation, BJones::calcWtScale and BPOLY::setApply. BPOLY loading samples only planned applicable SPW grids. MSStateGram/MSStateIndex and task selection activation, literal scalar text and selection-error setup. Traditional field-selected CT availability, CTTimeInterp1 relative Float time and context/frequency dispatch, full SPW-map rules and compressed valid-grid copies. CalLibraryGram/CalLibraryParse/CLPatchPanel typed grammar, task defaults/paths, slice/context/hardware map arrangement and first-buffer metadata. CalLibraryGram/CalLibraryParse/CLPatchPanel typed grammar, task defaults/paths, slice/context/hardware map arrangement and first-buffer metadata. KAntPosJones and EGainCurve coefficient flag rules, physical FPARAM time interpolation, and applycal-specific use of the existing CASA selector grammars and variant setup. Multi-MS task dispatch, parent flag backup and per-partition HISTORY at the CASA Python boundary.
source.result: All six modes, full task history, inverse linear-feed rotation and flags, trial validation and unavailable solver priors follow source laws, alongside the delivered channel/weight conventions. Review found an unavailable-BPOLY grid error; ordinary/strict/trial application and solver preapply regressions fail before and pass after the fix. Intent grammar, inactive argument retention, rejected-call corrected-column initialization/backups and empty-selection errors follow independent source and CASA comparisons. The two reviewed STATE-bound edge cases are fixed with independently failing-before CASA comparisons and native regressions. Reviewed chain regressions restore missing-side flagged identity, whole-table context admission before nearest-field slicing and default all-field series. Shared frequency math and constant-payload reuse preserve these equations. Task-library maps and missing-context/antenna semantics follow independent source laws and public CASA comparisons. The joint observation/scan correction matches explicit independently constrained CASA slices. Task-library maps, buffer-first observation, wildcard arranged-key collisions, literal table record identities, record type errors and delayed interpolation admission follow independent source laws and public CASA comparisons. The joint observation/scan correction matches explicit independently constrained CASA slices.

performance.scope: Historical 175 MB, 12000 rows, 6144000 complex samples; one worker, five alternating public-Python pairs per cache policy, predating completed HISTORY/modes. Full 21-parameter/state equivalence remains unfinished; final matched qualification follows functionality.
performance.result: Scalar gain reuse reduces compute median 0.228→0.077 s warm and 0.213→0.076 s cold. Full native 0.661 s warm/0.624 s cold versus CASA 0.259/0.349 s: still slower and CPU-limited. Gross repeated sampling is corrected; detailed tuning and final qualification follow functionality equivalence under owner direction on #979.

casa-bug-controls.kind: CASA crash and evident-intent corrections with independent controls
casa-bug-controls.scope: Five isolated probes and four working CASA control comparisons. The spline uses an independent natural curve.
casa-bug-controls.result: BPOLY nearest uses the field-independent CASA control. Per-scan crash controls, nearest-field ambiguity and joint library-map corrections retain their separate checks.

mms-oracle.kind: Public Python Multi-MS comparison and CASA flag restore
mms-oracle.scope: A physical two-partition dataset reused across eleven task scenarios.
mms-oracle.result: Eleven paired Multi-MS scenarios pass for all six modes, selected or failed partitions, callibrary, missing-partition setup and parent backup controls. CASA reads the native backup and restores its 744 changed FLAG samples exactly.

leakage-application.scope: Linear and circular four-product data with D, Df, Dgen, Dfgen, DLLS and DfLLS tables. Includes variable time and channel solutions, G/D/P order, flags, missing antennas, subselected channels, and unequal scalar and spectral weights.
leakage-application.result: 56 direct visibility comparisons and eight polarized MODEL_DATA gain solves passed. Maximum visibility normalized RMS was 1.45e-7 and maximum gain normalized RMS was 1.03e-7.
